posts.name: Rill Browser
posts.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
posts.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

posts.name: AUDR by Chargebee
posts.tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
posts.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

posts.name: OpenBot
posts.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
posts.description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

posts.name: Incredible
posts.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.
posts.description: Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

posts.name: Fuse AI
posts.tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.
posts.description: Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

posts.name: Extrovert
posts.tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
posts.description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

posts.name: Willow Knowledge
posts.tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.
posts.description: Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

posts.name: Coddy
posts.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
posts.description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

posts.name: iphone-use
posts.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API
posts.description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: NoteWorthy
posts.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
posts.description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

posts.name: Ghostifier
posts.tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
posts.description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

posts.name: Chunk
posts.tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
posts.description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.

posts.name: Pheebs
posts.tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
posts.description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

posts.name: Scumble
posts.tagline: The open-source editor for AI inpainting
posts.description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

posts.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
posts.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site
posts.description: Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

posts.name: ruOS
posts.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
posts.description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

posts.name: Doco
posts.tagline: Good Company. Music that fits.
posts.description: Meet Doco - an expressive Android companion for focus, music and everyday moments, with an optional Windows desktop visitor. Everyday mode is playful and warm; Focus mode cuts the noise with a little friendly sarcasm. Fully animated, zero setup. Connect Spotify and Doco plays music that fits the moment, staying close to your taste with room for something new. Add your own Gemini API key for camera-based reactions and AI captions. Pre-launch - join the waitlist at getdoco.app.

posts.name: Brnch
posts.tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era
posts.description: Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"

posts.name: CodeCrab
posts.tagline: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer
posts.description: CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

posts.name: Appto
posts.tagline: An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription
posts.description: Appto is an iOS app factory for your Mac. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, builds the App Store page with screenshots and ASO copy in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to Apple when you say go. After launch it shows every sale live, answers reviews, tracks keywords and suggests fixes. It runs on your Claude Code or Codex plan, so there are no token bills. I'm not a developer and shipped 10 apps with it.

posts.name: GeckIt
posts.tagline: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats
posts.description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

posts.name: mcpgawk
posts.tagline: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them
posts.description: An MCP server can change what its tools do after you approved it. Your agent will call the new one and never notice. mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and sits in the path: once a tool's description or power changes, the call is refused until you decide. The agent cannot approve its own way past it. Everything runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded. Free CLI, VS Code extension and MCP server. The gateway tier has a 7-day trial.

posts.name: Awakado
posts.tagline: Keep your Mac awake while your AI agents work
posts.description: A Mac menu-bar app that keeps your Mac awake while Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor work, then lets it sleep. Free. Pro keeps it awake with the lid closed and wakes it when a Claude Code usage limit resets.

posts.name: EasyCut
posts.tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos
posts.description: EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

posts.name: Notch Radio
posts.tagline: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch
posts.description: Notch Radio turns your MacBook's notch into a live radio. Hover it and it morphs into a full player with album art, real track titles and transport controls. Move away and it folds back into the hardware. Thousands of stations from the Radio Browser directory. Free for ever with five stations. One payment unlocks the rest: $9.99 at launch until 19 October, then $19.99. Nothing renews. No account, no analytics, no server. A notch is not required.

posts.name: Haptiker
posts.tagline: Volume, brightness and keyboard light on your trackpad edges
posts.description: Haptiker turns the edges of your Mac trackpad into sliders. Right edge: volume. Left: display brightness, external monitors too on Apple Silicon. Top: keyboard light. Haptic ticks, and scrolling works as before. 7-day free trial, then one payment.

posts.name: OrgComputers
posts.tagline: Workspace for your AI Agents
posts.description: OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

posts.name: Floani
posts.tagline: Create, animate, and share AI-powered diagrams
posts.description: Turn complex systems into clear visual stories. Floani combines an AI diagram editor with motion graphics: animate connections, guide viewers through scenes, and present your ideas in one canvas. Create with the built-in AI or connect Claude, Codex, and Cursor via MCP. Import Mermaid, share interactive diagrams, embed them anywhere, or export MP4 and GIF. Start free; advanced sharing, exports, and MCP are available on paid plans.

posts.name: StayCharted
posts.tagline: Train AI on your own categories. Text and pictures. No code
posts.description: Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

posts.name: MeetNote
posts.tagline: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call
posts.description: MeetNote writes a live transcript of your Google Meet calls in Chrome's side panel, then gives you a summary, decisions and action items when the call ends. No bot, no sign-up. Notes stay in your browser, and you pick the AI or run it on-device.

posts.name: Banger
posts.tagline: Win and keep customers with email automation your AI runs
posts.description: Banger brings automated Journeys, campaigns, product emails, mailboxes, and customer replies into one platform your AI can operate. Turn signups into active users, recover abandoned carts, and bring customers back. Your AI builds branded workflows, tests and translates emails, and answers replies from the same chat. Review and edit everything in the web app. Run it from ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI apps. Start free with 100 emails a day, unlimited contacts, and unlimited mailboxes.

posts.name: Kishi Notch
posts.tagline: Your MacBook notch, brought to life
posts.description: Kishi Notch turns your MacBook notch into an interactive island: reply to WhatsApp, Messages and Mail notifications, join your next meeting in one click, control music, run timers and see AirPods battery. Plus a detailed menu bar battery.

posts.name: Ranktune
posts.tagline: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic
posts.description: Track how your brand appears across AI search, see which AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, and uncover opportunities to improve your visibility. Ranktune combines AI visibility monitoring, citation tracking, referral traffic analytics, and content optimization in one platform.

posts.name: Review
posts.tagline: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI
posts.description: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Aster by AsterWise
posts.tagline: Intelligent model routing for code, agents and workflows
posts.description: No single model wins every task. Aster intelligently routes work across models: aster-code for coding agents and technical tasks; aster-work for custom agents, workflows and general work. Paid, prepaid usage. Originally launched September 23, 2026; this is Aster's separate Product Hunt appearance.

posts.name: Patchcord
posts.tagline: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ
posts.description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

posts.name: Ari Helper 7
posts.tagline: Private AI assistant, now with photo and film studios
posts.description: Ari Helper 7 is a private AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. New since the last launch: Photo Studio (heal, repair, denoise, colorize, upscale 4x, on device and inside Photos), Film Studio for shot-by-shot films and video clean-up, a live camera you can ask questions, on-device image generation, and your own OpenAI-compatible servers. Apple Intelligence, Gemma 4 or cloud keys you own. One $24.99 purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: The Sentient World
posts.tagline: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch.
posts.description: A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

posts.name: Lecta
posts.tagline: Turn your class notes into games with friends
posts.description: Upload a PDF, snap a handout, or add a lecture recording. Lecta turns your material into quiz matches and races you can play with friends. In Formula Race, correct answers make your car faster. Study solo with notes, quizzes, flashcards, and an AI tutor. Available on iPhone in English and Japanese, with a free plan. Web version coming soon.

posts.name: Customer Service AI for Etsy
posts.tagline: Answer Etsy buyer messages in seconds, always professional
posts.description: Answering Etsy buyer messages eats hours. Customer Service AI turns each one into seconds: type a short note and it writes a polished, friendly reply in your shop's voice, using the order details - right inside Etsy's reply box. A to-do list keeps every buyer you still owe an answer organized, and a memory of your shop keeps your answers consistent and professional. Nothing is sent until you press Send. 30 free replies.

posts.name: Signify
posts.tagline: AI Chat, for everyone who's ever just scrolled and signed
posts.description: Reading legal text without a legal background is hard, so people scroll to the bottom and sign. Signify AI Chat fixes that, right inside the signing experience: the whole contract in a few lines, parties, dates and payments at a glance, and answers to your questions without the jargon. Every answer points back to the exact lines in your document, so you check it yourself. Senders review faster, signers sign with confidence. Built right into Signify, where your documents get signed and managed.

posts.name: CronWatch
posts.tagline: Cron fails silently. This doesn’t.
posts.description: CronWatch records every run of your scheduled jobs in your own database, and speaks up when one is missed, fails, gets stuck, runs slow or costs too much. It is a library, not a service. No server to run, no account to make, and run history that stays in your database. An alert carries the error and the last lines of output to the channels you pick, and to Anthropic only if you turn on triage. MIT licensed.

posts.name: Codalio
posts.tagline: Spec-first AI software factory: idea to tested code
posts.description: Most AI builds break around feature four because nothing ever defined the product. Codalio starts there. Describe your idea in plain English and it writes a validated PRD and spec: user flows, data model, user stories and acceptance criteria. It then generates code against that spec, writes the tests from the same criteria, and traces every change back to a requirement before the merge. Codalio Cloud takes you 95–98% of the way to production grade. Start with a free PRD.

posts.name: Defang Station
posts.tagline: Always-on Claude Code and Codex agents with Superpowers.
posts.description: Superpowers for Claude Code and Codex: a computer of their own that doesn't go away. Your agents can react to GitHub, Linear or your app while you're out. Your site stays live at a link you can share and ships to your own cloud with Defang Deploy. Sign in with the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for, and drive it from their own apps. Built on Agent Box, the MIT-licensed runtime you can self-host. $39/month flat, no token markup. First hour free, then a 7-day trial.

posts.name: Factorai
posts.tagline: IDE is dead. Long live the ADE (Agentic Development Env)
posts.description: Fatcorai is the Agentic Development Environment (ADE) for the AI era. It is a free, community-driven, open-source desktop app for running coding agents. Sessions, not files, are the unit of work: see which agent is working or waiting on you, review its diff, search every conversation and schedule routines.

posts.name: Ansight
posts.tagline: Recursive self improvement for mobile apps.
posts.description: Ansight gives your coding agent the ability to operate mobile apps and inspect what happens inside them. It brings UI interactions, logs, network requests, crashes, performance and app state together in one queryable session. Through a CLI, your existing agent can reproduce bugs, investigate causes and verify fixes on simulators, emulators and real devices, with recorded evidence you can review. Built for native and cross-platform apps, with custom tools for your app’s own logic.

posts.name: IdeasNest
posts.tagline: Share your startup idea and get real feedback, free
posts.description: IdeasNest is a public gallery where anyone can post a startup idea and get feedback from founders and mentors. It's free, no pitch decks, no paywall. Every idea answers four questions: who it's for, why there's demand, your ideal customers and how you'd reach them, so readers have something real to respond to. An optional investor section covers the commercial side. Nothing asks you to reveal your IP. Private "nests" let a cohort, university or incubator share ideas with just their group.

posts.name: Wrenchmark
posts.tagline: Find unused AI seats in ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Cursor
posts.description: Wrenchmark connects to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor and Notion AI and shows who uses each paid seat. It flags seats nobody opens, catches people paying for two tools that do one job, and ranks what to cut from your AI spend by annual cost.

posts.name: CoralBricks
posts.tagline: Fast affordable AI for coding and research.
posts.description: GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 at up to 469 output tokens per second, with cached input billed at $0. One OpenAI-compatible API for coding and research agents.

posts.name: On.design
posts.tagline: Design, together — again
posts.description: A home for your work. A community of your peers. A place for designers to share what they’re making, find people they admire, and have conversations about the work. Home for designers.

posts.name: Flow by Aivolut
posts.tagline: Turn your WordPress blog into an automated growth engine
posts.description: Your blog runs itself. Flow researches keywords, writes SEO articles, and publishes directly to WordPress automatically. Built for bloggers, marketers, and agencies, Flow goes beyond AI writing by creating connected content clusters that build topical authority and drive long-term organic growth. No prompts, no copy-paste, no content calendar headaches.

posts.name: lilAgents
posts.tagline: Automate busywork, get your team's time back
posts.description: lilAgents automates the busywork humans don't need to do, so you can focus on doing what moves the business forward.

posts.name: Axisize
posts.tagline: turn any font into a variable font
posts.description: Drop a static TTF or OTF and get a variable font with weight, width, slant and optical size axes. Free, runs entirely in your browser — your fonts are never uploaded.

posts.name: Uplift Indie
posts.tagline: Real first reviews for indie apps, from indie devs
posts.description: Launching an app with zero ratings is brutal. On Uplift Indie you book a day for your iOS or Android app, and on that day other indie devs download it and leave an honest review. You do the same for theirs. Free, and only for apps under 1,000 ratings.

posts.name: Planes
posts.tagline: 100+ interactive components for interfaces that feel alive
posts.description: 120+ animated React components: WebGL shaders, AI chat UI, data tables, carousels, physical controls and landing sections. Built on React, Tailwind and Motion, installed with the shadcn CLI or your AI agent through MCP. Pay once, own the source.

posts.name: BP Builder
posts.tagline: Your 5-year business plan, built through a conversation
posts.description: Building a financial plan means days in a spreadsheet, or paying someone to do it. BP Builder does it through a conversation. An assistant interviews you about your business, adapting to your model and sector. A calculation engine turns that into a full 5-year plan: P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, debt schedule, break-even. Benchmarks across 30 industries fill the gaps. Export to Excel in one click: 10 sheets, 6 charts, live formulas your accountant can audit.

posts.name: Ask Rakhie: Revenue Leak Scanner
posts.tagline: Find where your website is leaking revenue, in one click
posts.description: Ask Rakhie is a free Chrome extension that shows how much revenue a website is losing, and where. Open any site, click once, and it runs 44 checks across conversion paths, form friction, page speed, trust signals and pricing clarity. You get a Revenue Health Score out of 100, an estimate of the monthly and yearly leak, the top 3 leaks with evidence, and a 30/60/90-day fix plan. The scan runs on your own device. Built for founders, ecommerce and SaaS owners, marketers and agencies.

posts.name: Quardy
posts.tagline: Loyalty cards in Apple & Google Wallet, no app for customers
posts.description: Quardy turns the paper loyalty card into a card in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. Shops display a QR code, customers scan it and add their card in seconds, with no app and no account. The merchant scans it at each visit from the Quardy app: stamps, points or cashback update live in the wallet. Free up to 50 customers with your logo and colours. Pro adds unlimited customers, targeted push messages and gift cards. Made by an indie founder in France.

posts.name: Pavago
posts.tagline: A Frictionless Hiring Platform
posts.description: Scout OS is a frictionless talent marketplace. Search vetted remote candidates by skill, watch their intro videos, then shortlist, interview, and send the contract from one app. Free to browse. $99/mo to interview. Pay only when you hire, with a 60-day replacement guarantee.

posts.name: It's a Numbers Game
posts.tagline: Job hunting shouldn't be this difficult!
posts.description: If you're out of work and applying to dozens of roles, you know the drill. retype your name, address, phone and work history on every single form. It's a numbers game (itsanumbersgame.xyz) fills those twenty fields from your saved profile, logs each job on a tracking board, and warns you when you've already applied somewhere. Import your resume, add the Chrome extension, and spend your energy on the applications instead of the paperwork. Free forever.

posts.name: DotQuit
posts.tagline: Quit macOS apps when their last window closes
posts.description: DotQuit is an open-source, lightweight macOS menu bar utility written natively in Swift. Closing an app's last window on macOS often leaves it idling in memory. DotQuit solves this by gracefully quitting apps when their last window closes. • Native Swift with ~19MB RAM footprint • AXObserver-based gentle termination (no force-kill) • Customizable app whitelist • Apple Notarized & open source (GPLv3)

posts.name: Timecard 
posts.tagline: Screen Time alternative that prints your day from the notch
posts.description: A screen time tracker for Mac: time per app and website, history kept forever, and your day printed as a timecard every evening. No account, 100% local.

posts.name: Fokusflow
posts.tagline: All your apps. All your services. One place.
posts.description: Keep every app’s frontend and backend services together. Spot provider outages. Track recurring revenue per app and across your portfolio with the Stripe pilot.

posts.name: SlopScan
posts.tagline: See the slop in your design. Decide what to fix
posts.description: Audit your website against professional design skills.SlopScan audits a live site or project ZIP for generic, AI-made design: default gradients, flat type, off-scale spacing, weak hierarchy. You get numbered marks on your page, why each one matters, and one prompt for Cursor or Claude to fix what you keep.

posts.name: LLM Readiness Check
posts.tagline: See if ChatGPT and other AI can read your website.
posts.description: Free LLM Readiness Check: test 15 AI crawlers across 8 AI engines, including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot. Get a score, fixes and a robots.txt snippet in 10 seconds.

posts.name: Notice – Mindful Screen Time
posts.tagline: Dynamic Island timer that makes screen time visible
posts.description: Notice is a free iOS timer for mindful screen time. It sits in the Dynamic Island and works with Shortcuts so you can see how long you have been on your phone. It is about noticing how long you have been on your phone, not blocking apps. No account required.

posts.name: ata-validator
posts.tagline: Fast, correct JSON Schema validation for JavaScript
posts.description: ata is a JSON Schema validator for JavaScript. It passes the whole official test suite and ranks first in all six validation and parsing tables on schemabenchmarks.dev. Errors say what is wrong and where, down to line and column. It runs where code generation is blocked, such as Cloudflare Workers, and its pattern engine is linear-time, so one crafted string cannot stall a server. With the bundler plugin, new Validator(schema) compiles away to a few KB.

posts.name: Amanah Budget
posts.tagline: Halal budgeting, zakat & goals for Muslim families
posts.description: Amanah Budget is halal-first budgeting for Muslim families, with Islamic principles built in rather than bolted on. Calculate zakat across all four madhabs, catch interest and give it away, screen your portfolio, and plan for Ramadan, Eid and Hajj, on your own or as a family. Live on iOS and Android in the US, and launching on Product Hunt soon. Get notified and be first in line: your feedback on the zakat and family flows will shape what comes next, inshaAllah.

posts.name: Tamis
posts.tagline: Screen thousands of documents without reading them all
posts.description: Tamis reads every document against your brief, shows the likeliest first and learns from each decision. A random audit then proves what is left in the unread pile. For systematic reviews, drug safety monitoring and contract due diligence.

posts.name: Tiny Store
posts.tagline: Offer local preorders & pick ups anywhere
posts.description: When the world is going crazy over AI and world domination, at Tiny Store we want to empower local economies and human-made goods. Our newest update features our refreshed preorder and flexible pick-up experience, so if you're a maker or small business owner who sells from home, at markets, or move around in craftfairs - tiny is built for you!

posts.name: FINN AI
posts.tagline: Close live deals at rocket speed.
posts.description: FINN is a Chrome extension that listens to your sales calls and whispers the right question, the objection handler and the exact number - in under a second.

posts.name: NeonSlush
posts.tagline: Personalized movie picks and Slush ratings in one watchlist.
posts.description: NeonSlush helps you find your next movie with personalized picks shaped by your tastes, moods, genres, and streaming subscriptions. Browse movies by mood and see where they stream, rent, or buy. Save films to your watchlist, track what you’ve watched, and rate movies with the community Slush scale. When a saved movie becomes included with one of your subscribed services, get an in-app alert and, if enabled, an email. Explore cast, crew, and franchise connections. For easier, better movie nights.

posts.name: Boop
posts.tagline: Kaomoji keyboard for iPhone and Mac. Never send plain text.
posts.description: Boop puts 24,563 kaomoji one tap away on iPhone and one shortcut away on Mac. 37 moods, instant search, saved favorites. Type "shrug", get ┐( ˘_˘)┌, in any app. Free, offline, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

posts.name: Hyperpage
posts.tagline: Build a free business site in Chrome, on your own domain
posts.description: Hyperpage turns your Google listing into a real business website, right in Chrome. Chrome's built-in AI drafts it on your computer, you edit anything, then publish free to your own Cloudflare and domain. 27 industry kits, 5 styles, leads straight to you.

posts.name: FinCatch Studio
posts.tagline: AI research for connected financial insights
posts.description: FinCatch Studio is an AI research workspace for investment professionals, powered by an event-centric financial knowledge graph and a personal memory graph. It connects filings, earnings transcripts, companies, people, events, and market data to help users move from raw information to clear source-backed insights. Ask questions, uncover relationships, research companies and themes, write reports, build models, and monitor impactful changes in one place.

posts.name: Riley
posts.tagline: Your pet's health, finally in one place.
posts.description: Riley is the all-in-one pet health platform built around your individual pet. Keep a lifelong medical record, get personalised 24/7 health support, understand vet notes and quotes, access independent veterinary second opinions, and manage insurance claims and appeals - all in one place. Unlike generic advice, Riley uses your pet's health history, medications and records to provide more relevant support throughout their life. Built by pet owners, for pet owners. Because they're family.

posts.name: Mainbrella
posts.tagline: A cloud computer for every AI agent.
posts.description: A cloud computer for every AI agent. Create isolated Linux workspaces, execute commands, and transfer files through the Mainbrella API.

posts.name: DesignCat
posts.tagline: Focused AI Generation Workspace. Not luring you into slop.
posts.description: DesignCat is a focused AI generation workspace for images, video, and audio. Create and refine in one coherent interface, and compare model quality and cost before you spend. It’s built to help you make the content you came to make, without the chaos of a slop casino.

posts.name: Postrion X
posts.tagline: Grow on X by replying, not by posting into the void
posts.description: Every morning Postrion finds the posts in your niche worth replying to: fresh, already moving, by people big enough to be seen. Each comes with a reply drafted from your own experience. You read it and press send. Nothing posts without your click. Also inside: a writer with a live X preview, scheduling, and a Monday letter on who came, who followed and who clicked.

posts.name: HaulerPro Dispatch
posts.tagline: One login for every carrier you dispatch
posts.description: HaulerPro Dispatch is a TMS built for independent dispatch services. Work every carrier you dispatch from one login: switch between carriers, set up their trucks, dispatch loads, and send invoices or submit them to factoring when the owner allows it. Each carrier keeps its own company account and records, so dispatcher and carrier work every load together. Fee terms the owner approves track your dispatcher fee on each delivered load. $59 per carrier per month, 14-day free trial, no credit card.

posts.name: nefa.io
posts.tagline: Ship your code. We’ll handle the infrastructure
posts.description: nefa.io runs your Node.js app on a managed server in Switzerland. Connect a GitHub repo, push, and it's live with SSL, monitoring and system updates handled for you. Domains and DNS live in the same console. From €29.90/month, 5-day free trial

posts.name: Audio Lab
posts.tagline: Edit audio, automate effects, and separate stems
posts.description: Record or import audio and video, trim and fade waveforms, and shape your sound with 20+ effects including EQ, compression, reverb and delay. Record effect automation in real time, separate vocals and instruments into stems, and export your finished audio. Audio Lab gives musicians, podcasters and video creators a focused workspace on web, iOS and Android. Free features with optional paid upgrades; stem separation uses credits.

posts.name: Pluely 1.1
posts.tagline: Invisible AI overlay that transcribes calls and answers live
posts.description: Pluely is a native desktop overlay for macOS, Windows and Linux that stays invisible on screen shares and recordings. It listens to your call, transcribes it live with speaker labels, and drafts an answer the moment a question is asked. Ask mode takes a typed question, a screenshot or a file. New in 1.1: meeting detection, a transcription-only mode, an automatic recap with decisions and action items, and Pro purchase inside the app. Everything is stored on your computer. Free with your own key.

posts.name: HaulerPro Dispatch
posts.tagline: One login for every carrier you dispatch
posts.description: HaulerPro Dispatch is a TMS built for independent dispatch services. Work every carrier you dispatch from one login: switch between carriers, set up their trucks, dispatch loads, and send invoices or submit them to factoring when the owner allows it. Each carrier keeps its own company account and records, so dispatcher and carrier work every load together. Fee terms the owner approves track your dispatcher fee on each delivered load. $59 per carrier per month, 14-day free trial, no credit card.

posts.name: Lokka: Offline AI photo library search
posts.tagline: Search and chat with your photos and videos. 100% on-device.
posts.description: Lokka finds any photo or video from a plain description. Type "receipt from a restaurant" or "dog running on the beach at sunset" and it finds it, even among thousands of photos. You can also chat with your library, like "show me whiteboard notes from meetings" or "find screenshots of flight bookings." An AI vision model runs entirely on your iPhone, so it understands what's in each picture. No cloud, no account, no uploads. Your photos never leave your device.

posts.name: One Design
posts.tagline: One design, endless outputs.
posts.description: Most image tools do one job and want your files on their server. One Design is 19 tools in one place, and nothing leaves your device: every tool runs in the browser. Resize for every channel, compress, cut out, watermark, blur faces, redact screenshots, make favicons and App Store shots. Save your brand once and it's there in every tool. Send results straight to the next tool. Coming soon: 15+ more tools, and Workflows to chain them and run a whole batch in one go. Free while in beta.

posts.name: Postrion X
posts.tagline: Grow on X by replying, not by posting into the void
posts.description: Every morning Postrion finds the posts in your niche worth replying to: fresh, already moving, by people big enough to be seen. Each comes with a reply drafted from your own experience. You read it and press send. Nothing posts without your click. Also inside: a writer with a live X preview, scheduling, and a Monday letter on who came, who followed and who clicked.

posts.name: Should You Sign It?
posts.tagline: Know what you're signing, before you sign it
posts.description: Scan a lease, job offer or any contract. Get a plain-language summary, the clauses worth a second look, quoted word for word, and the questions to ask before you sign. It runs on Apple Intelligence on your iPhone, so your documents never leave it.

posts.name: marble work
posts.tagline: From tool chaos to marketing symphony
posts.description: AI agents. Real projects. One tool. Most teams run their AI in one app and their projects, clients and hours in another. marble work does both. Describe AI teammates in plain words, connect your tools and chain their steps with human ones: the agent researches, you review, the agent delivers. Plus projects, clients, budgets, time tracking and attendance. Bring your own AI key, no credits, no markup.

posts.name: Tinyhat
posts.tagline: Promote your Muse to Chief of Staff.
posts.description: Tinyhat gives Muse a team of AI specialists and a shared office to handle your tasks. You talk to Muse in one chat; it delegates work to agents for marketing, coding, design, and more. Your Office task board shows who's doing what, how the work is progressing, and what needs your attention. Get help from a whole team without managing every agent yourself.

posts.name: Mojirama
posts.tagline: Fast movie search that understands what you mean
posts.description: Search 1.26 million movies and TV shows the way you'd describe them to a friend. Type the plot, an actor, a character, a studio, a mood, or just a few emoji. It finds the film before you finish typing, typos and all. No sign-up, no filters to click. Titles also carry up to three emojis, and there's a guessing game hidden behind the "don't click here" button.

posts.name: FOWS
posts.tagline: The future of web solutions runs on AI agents.
posts.description: Most website tools stop at publish. FOWS starts there. It's an agentic growth platform: prompt, refine and publish your site with hosting and domains included, then switch on AI agents that keep working. The Blog Agent publishes posts on schedule, the SEO/AEO Agent optimizes for Google and AI answer engines and fixes issues, and a chatbot answers visitors 24/7. Track traffic, rankings and AI mentions in one dashboard. Agencies run multiple client sites from one workspace.

posts.name: Sequo
posts.tagline: Your idea to an ordered build plan your AI agent can follow
posts.description: You describe your idea in a sentence. Sequo asks what it needs to know, then writes the plan: the steps in dependency order, eight documents that live in your repo, and one copy-ready prompt per step for Claude Code or Codex. Each step also tells you which part is yours, the API key or the account an agent cannot set up for you. Web apps from scratch. Free for one project.

posts.name: Jev Show
posts.tagline: Discover projects built with Jev, curated by Jev
posts.description: Discover tools, games, SDKs and demos built with TypeSafe’s Jev model. Jev Show automatically finds and judges projects, lets you browse by category, and exposes its run logs. Submit a link without an account; Jev checks it against the same publishing rules.

posts.name: InsurStaq
posts.tagline: Private AI security engineer for your Mac
posts.description: InsurStaq is a private AI security engineer for your Mac. Point it at a repo: it maps routes and auth, finds injection, exposed secrets (Git history too), vulnerable dependencies and IaC risks, and traces attack paths from the internet to the exact line. InsurStaq's own security model, fine-tuned for security work, explains findings and drafts fixes you approve, each re-scanned on your Mac. Readiness evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and OWASP ASVS. Your code never leaves the machine.

posts.name: HumanAtlas
posts.tagline: Explore 2,900 body structures in 3D, free in your browser
posts.description: HumanAtlas is a free, interactive 3D anatomy atlas for students and curious minds. Rotate a male or female body, peel back skin, muscle and bone one layer at a time, and click any of ~2,900 structures to learn what it is. Watch the heart beat in physiology mode, quiz yourself by finding structures in 3D, take guided tours, and look up 182 diseases linked to the organs they affect. No account, no install, no paywall.

posts.name: FanRoute
posts.tagline: WhatsApp storefront for India's Instagram sellers
posts.description: FanRoute turns an Instagram bio link into a shop. Sellers list products with photos and rupee prices; customers tap "Order on WhatsApp" and pay the seller directly by UPI. No website, no checkout, no commission. Free link-in-bio; Pro is ₹249 a month.

posts.name: WhisperJot
posts.tagline: Voice dictation that never leaves your machine
posts.description: Hold a hotkey, say the thing, and clean punctuated text lands wherever your cursor already is — email, editor, chat. No window to switch to, no paste step, no cleanup pass. The speech model runs on your own machine by default: zero outbound requests during a local dictation, and it keeps working with the Wi-Fi off. An optional cloud engine is one switch away. macOS, Windows and Linux (beta) on one account. Unlimited dictation, no meters. From $5/month, or $199 once for lifetime.

posts.name: VeloCapture — GTM + Bid Platform
posts.tagline: Timing beats targeting
posts.description: VeloCapture is an AI-powered lead generation and bid intelligence platform. Tell us what you sell, and VeloCapture finds organizations likely to buy, surfaces pre-RFP signals, discovers relevant bids and RFPs, and ranks opportunities by fit. Its Lead Engine includes extensive U.S. healthcare provider data, while AI helps teams qualify opportunities, plan contract vehicles, and draft responses.

posts.name: MATIKS
posts.tagline: Mental Math Duels & Puzzle Battles | Train Your Brain
posts.description: Matiks is a competitive brain-training app that turns math, memory, logic, and speed challenges into real-time 1v1 games. With 5M+ downloads and 2M+ monthly active users, Matiks makes cognitive training feel like gaming. Challenge real players, sharpen your mental math skills, improve your speed, track your ELO rating, and climb the leaderboard.
